query:
SELECT ceo.id, cp.empresa, ceo.etapa, ceo.observacao, ceo.registrado_por, ceo.created_at 
FROM cobranca_etapa_obs ceo 
JOIN cobranca_planilha cp ON cp.id = ceo.planilha_id 
WHERE ceo.registrado_por LIKE '%importado%' 
ORDER BY ceo.id
